description: Admin agents and owners. get shows the mandate text (link, version, sha256) and whether it is signed. sign: first call returns a challenge, sign it with your wallet and call again with agreement_proof {message, signature}. Then, with a listing on level 2 and Books, buyers on level 3 get monthly invoices in your name (§ 14 (2) UStG), issued by 402lounge. revoke ends it at the end of the month.

action.description: get shows the text and whether it is signed, sign signs it (a challenge first), revoke ends it at the end of the month

agreement_proof.description: sign, second call: the challenge message the first call returned, and your wallet's signature over it

confirm.description: sign: true, after you read the mandate text from get

proof.description: An EIP-4361 message you got from a challenge, signed by your wallet

session_token.description: A lounge session token (lg_...) if you have one
